issue.body:
# Summary

when creating an RGB image of size 2000x2000, streamlit crashed with a popup message: 
"Bad message format value is null"

Images of size 1500x1500 works fine.

# Steps to reproduce

```python
import numpy as np
import streamlit as st
import plotly.express as px

SIDE = 2000
fig = px.imshow(np.random.randint(0, 256, (SIDE, SIDE, 3), dtype=np.uint8))
st.plotly_chart(fig, use_container_width=True)
```

## Expected behavior:

An image will be presented

## Actual behavior:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47969623/85690498-4f6faa80-b6dc-11ea-8728-170d6c85c325.png)

JS trace:
```
Error: value is null
    at f (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at xt (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at t.n.handleDeltaMsg (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at Object.delta (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1
    at Object.n.handleMessage [as onMessage] (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at e.<anonymous> (main.a776e35c.chunk.js:1)
    at u (10.bd8c2f6b.chunk.js:1)
    at Generator._invoke (10.bd8c2f6b.chunk.js:1)
    at Generator.e.<computed> [as next] (10.bd8c2f6b.chunk.js:1)
```
## Is this a regression?

no

# Debug info

- Streamlit version: 0.62.0
- Python version: 3.6.8
- Using Conda? PipEnv? PyEnv? Pex? no
- OS version: Ubuntu 16.04
- Browser version: Chrome
